answers.reason: The president leads the university and chairs its central bodies, and the senate is the central body that decides on the statutes, structure, and strategy of the whole university.
The chancellor is specifically responsible for the budget, and members only take part in the one body that deals with their own delimited questions.
The president only takes part in the central body for overall university strategy and does not sit in committees dealing with other kinds of questions like faculty appointments.
The faculty council is chaired by the dean to decide faculty affairs, and higher officers do not sit in bodies that deal with other kinds of questions.
The study commission deals with faculty teaching and degree programmes, which is outside the president's single place of participation.
The examination board handles individual student examination matters, and the president does not sit in bodies dealing with other kinds of questions.
This round awards internal faculty research grants, whereas the president only participates in the central body matching their overall leadership role.
Rewriting module descriptions for a degree programme is a specific teaching matter outside the president's single place of participation.
Choosing laboratory equipment is a specific operational question, and the president does not sit in bodies dealing with other kinds of questions.
Planning the orientation week for new students is outside the central university strategy body where the president takes part.
